nol.evidence: David 2026-10-30: "Figure out the NOL's from Matt." US federal NOLs ~$20.1M (expire 2036-37; US ops already taxable) are not added. Q2 2026 10-Q discloses no updated NOL balance. sbc.evidence: David 2026-10-30: "Stock comp is held constant until EBITDA is positive and then is a fixed % of sales." David's rule (P): SBC held at the year-0 level $17.679M (10-K FY2025) until the first EBITDA-positive year, then a fixed % of sales. Bear EBITDA is never positive, so SBC stays $17.679M every year. The 5.0% is [S], not David's: chosen from launched rare-disease/gene-therapy peers at scale (10-K XBRL ShareBasedCompensation / revenue: Sarepta FY2025 $123.4M / $2,198.2M = 5.6%, FY2024 9.7%; PTC FY2025 $74.5M / $1,730.7M = 4.3%, FY2024 9.2%; Krystal FY2025 $54.5M / $389.1M = 14.0%, smaller scale); uniQure FY2025 SBC $17.7M on $16.1M revenue is not meaningful. FLAG: David to override the %. Revenue = rev3 path in Finagle years (FY26E-FY33E forecast totals; FY34E-FY35E per Finagle's margin-path formula with default gt, replicated without running Finagle). Full list with source prompt is kept by Finagle (normalize_assumed_paths keeps stated sources), so forecast_sbc is not called and sbc_rate_terminal is not used.
